purpose: Source-verified, non-secret contracts for the 1.2 payment-health readers (FEATURE-PLAN.md item 1). Every name below was read from a tagged release; provenance and checksums are in the run receipt receipts/payment-source-verification.md. All values in synthetic_cases are invented test shapes, never store data.

Every WooCommerce fact pinned for 10.9.0 and 11.2.2 below was re-read at this tag commit; see woocommerce.current_version_check. 10.9.0 (sources.woocommerce) stays the minimum. The 30 cited files are byte-identical to the WordPress.org woocommerce.11.3.0.zip copies.

cross_check.note: Newest tag installable on the toolkit's WooCommerce 10.9 floor. Gateway IDs, settlement code, logger and Action Scheduler hook names and groups are identical to 5.5.3.

method_ids.note: Card and Link orders are recorded under the main gateway ID 'stripe'; other UPE methods use 'stripe_' plus the method's STRIPE_ID.

delayed_authorisation.manual_effect: order set to on-hold with a transaction ID and no paid timestamp until the merchant captures; this is verified authorisation behaviour, not a broken checkout
delayed_authorisation.async_pending_charge_effect: a captured charge still pending at Stripe sets on-hold with a transaction ID; the webhook later completes it

settings.type: array (serialized); non-array is treated by Stripe as an empty array
settings.enabled: 'yes' means enabled; anything else is not enabled
settings.testmode: 'yes' means test mode; missing key inside an array means live (Stripe default 'no')

mode.unknown_when: settings option absent or not an array (toolkit rule; Stripe itself would fall back to live)

webhook_state.storage: separate scalar options, not keys of a structured option
webhook_state.timestamp_format: integer UTC Unix seconds stored as int or digit-only string
webhook_state.valid_value: scalar whose string form is ctype_digit; 0 means none recorded since monitoring began
webhook_state.invalid_value: non-scalar, empty string, sign, decimal point, exponent or any non-digit: Stripe reads it as 0, the toolkit treats it as malformed
webhook_state.missing_value: get_option default 0 in Stripe; the toolkit treats an absent option as missing, not as 0
webhook_state.success_written: after signature validation passes, the event's account matches and the event is dispatched (including deferred dispatch to Action Scheduler); value is the Stripe event's created time, not local processing time
webhook_state.failure_written: when signature validation fails; value is local time() at receipt
neither_written: request is not POST to wc-api=wc_stripe
event belongs to another Stripe account (acknowledged 200)
webhook_state.reset: when monitoring_began_at for the active mode reads as 0, Stripe sets it to now and resets success and failure to 0 and last_error to validation_succeeded
webhook_state.status_code_logic: Stripe's own status: success > failure is nominal; both 0 is none received; success > 0 otherwise is failure after success; else failure with no prior success. Equal non-zero values fall into failure after success in Stripe's message, which the toolkit does not adopt.
webhook_state.clock_caveat: success uses Stripe's event creation clock, failure uses the site clock; a successfully processed retry of an older event keeps an older success time

webhook_required_for_order_completion.reason: card payments that succeed are completed at checkout in process_response via payment_complete; the webhook is not the only completion path
webhook_required_for_order_completion.async_pending_charges: completed by webhook, but which stripe_* IDs are always async is not verified per method in this pass

logs.error_level_note: WC_Stripe_Logger::error does not check Stripe's own logging setting; WooCommerce's logging_enabled and level threshold still apply
logs.context_warning: the failure entry's context carries request headers and the event body; never output it

action_scheduler.note: Hooks verified in the webhook handler; not claimed to be the plugin's complete hook list.

stripe.replacement_note: Legacy method order 'stripe_sepa' maps to UPE 'sepa_debit' (gateway ID 'stripe_sepa_debit'). Legacy 'stripe' maps to UPE 'card', which keeps gateway ID 'stripe', so it is not a replacement.
stripe.registry_risk: Constructing Stripe UPE method objects reads payment method configuration; when its 20-minute cache is cold and the PMC API is enabled, Stripe fetches it from api.stripe.com and writes a cooldown option. Payment-health must not force gateway construction to read enabled state.

method_ids.note: processor_path IDs settle through OrderProcessor and PaymentsStatusHandlingTrait in the checkout request. The local APMs, Multibanco and OXXO set the order to pending and redirect to a PayPal payer-action URL; a PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED webhook later calls payment_complete for pending or on-hold orders. Pay upon Invoice sets on-hold. 'ppcp-recaptcha' is a WooCommerce integration ID, not a gateway.

kind.instant_meaning: a successful payment marks the order paid (capture COMPLETED -> payment_complete) or on-hold (capture PENDING, or authorize intent) in the checkout request; no source path leaves a successfully paid order pending for hours

delayed_authorisation.setting: authorize_only in option woocommerce-ppcp-data-settings (new settings model, default false); the legacy intent value 'authorize' migrates to it
delayed_authorisation.effect: authorize intent: transaction ID set, order on-hold 'Awaiting payment', no paid timestamp, until the merchant captures; verified authorisation behaviour, not a broken checkout

kind.capture_pending_effect: capture status PENDING or FAILED sets on-hold 'Awaiting payment' after the transaction ID is stored
kind.capture_declined_effect: order set to failed and the checkout throws
kind.exceptions: a vaulted card or Fastlane payment needing a 3D Secure challenge, and the redirect fallback for Google Pay, return a payer-action redirect and leave the order pending until the buyer returns; abandoned redirects stay pending like any redirect checkout
kind.unknown_reason: local APMs, OXXO and Pay upon Invoice complete only after a redirect, voucher or invoice payment confirmed by webhook, so normal settlement can leave orders pending or on-hold for hours or days

logs.main_logger_enabled_when: settings enable_logging is true (default false) or the plugin is onboarding, then filter woocommerce_paypal_payments_is_logging_enabled; otherwise a NullLogger drops every entry, including errors
logs.message_prefix: each message is prefixed '#<4-digit random id> - ' or with a request-kind label; treat the prefix as untrusted text
logs.verified_error_note: written by ProcessPaymentTrait::handle_payment_failure when the order is set to failed; not a webhook-delivery failure pattern
logs.webhook_failure_note: no webhook-delivery or signature-validation log pattern was verified, so a red log rule cannot use this family

hooks.note: scheduled 5 minutes after a Pay upon Invoice order; fails the order if PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED was not received

action_scheduler.group_note: an empty group means no group argument was passed to as_schedule_single_action
action_scheduler.card_checkout_jobs: none: card and PayPal checkout capture runs in the request, not in Action Scheduler

paypal_payments.webhook_note: no local webhook-health record was reviewed for this family; the toolkit has no supported adapter, so the webhook check is not applicable

method_ids.note: Card, Link, Google Pay and Apple Pay orders are recorded under 'woocommerce_payments'; Amazon Pay and every other method under its split ID. A split gateway object is registered for each of the 18 payment method definitions except card, so the three IDs in registered_without_orders exist in the registry (with their own settings options) but orders are not recorded under them.

kind.instant_meaning: the checkout request creates and confirms the payment intent; status succeeded calls payment_complete with the intent ID as transaction ID

delayed_authorisation.setting: manual_capture in option woocommerce_woocommerce_payments_settings (default 'no'); the card gateway's value applies to every method
delayed_authorisation.effect: intent requires_capture: order on-hold with the intent ID as transaction ID and no paid timestamp until captured; verified authorisation behaviour

kind.processing_effect: intent processing (an asynchronous method still settling) sets on-hold, not pending
kind.requires_action_effect: intent requires_action leaves the order pending (3D Secure or bank redirect) until the browser confirms or the redirect handler or webhook updates it; Multibanco (offline) sets on-hold
kind.unknown_reason: the plugin-side status mapping is verified, but which intent status each split method returns at checkout is decided by the payment server, not by plugin source

logs.main_logger_enabled_when: dev mode, or enable_logging === 'yes' in woocommerce_woocommerce_payments_settings (default 'no'); otherwise entries at every level, including errors, are dropped
logs.ungated_entries: WC_Payments_Utils::log_to_wc() writes to source 'woopayments' without the setting check; its callers are onboarding, gateway ordering, promotions and token-service failures, not payment failures
logs.source_note: the source is 'woopayments', not the plugin slug 'woocommerce-payments'
logs.webhook_failure_note: webhook-reliability processing logs 'Failed processing event ' at error level through the gated main logger, but no webhook-delivery or signature-validation pattern equivalent to Stripe's was verified, so no red log rule is supplied

hooks.note: webhook reliability: fetch events the server could not deliver
webhook reliability: process one fetched event
queued when a payment is marked complete
saved payment method update after a token payment
order tracking sent to the payment server
order tracking sent to the payment server

action_scheduler.note: Hooks verified at their schedule_job call sites; schedule_job defaults the group to woocommerce_payments. Not claimed to be the plugin's complete hook list (migration and remediation hooks were not reviewed).

woopayments.webhook_note: no local webhook-health record was reviewed for this family; the toolkit has no supported adapter, so the webhook check is not applicable

square.verified_in: wave 2, lane kinds; tag 5.5.3, cross-checked at 5.5.1

kind.instant_meaning: process_payment creates the Square payment in the checkout request; approved and not held calls payment_complete after the transaction ID is stored

delayed_authorisation.setting: transaction_type in the gateway's WC_Settings_API settings (default 'charge'); 'authorization' authorises only
delayed_authorisation.effect: authorisation-only or a card or wallet status AUTHORIZED: order on-hold ('Transaction Held for Review') with a transaction ID and no paid timestamp; verified authorisation behaviour

kind.unknown_reason: gift_cards_pay defines no process_payment of its own; its settlement path was not verified

logs.level_note: every Square plugin entry goes through WC_Logger::add(), whose default level is notice (WooCommerce includes/class-wc-logger.php:136 in 10.9.0, 11.2.2 and 11.3.0), so the plugin writes no error-level entries; 'error' here is a source name, not a level
logs.enabled_when: the plugin's debug setting logs, checked by Plugin::log() and Payment_Gateway::debug_log()
logs.toolkit_consequence: an error/fatal log check cannot observe this family; treat Square log diagnostics as unavailable, not as an empty healthy log

hooks.note: weekly OAuth connection refresh; a failure can affect later payments but is not a payment job

action_scheduler.card_checkout_jobs: none: card and Cash App Pay charges run in the checkout request

square.webhook_note: no local webhook-health record was reviewed for this family; the toolkit has no supported adapter, so the webhook check is not applicable

cod.default_status: processing, or on-hold when the order has a downloadable item
cod.paid_timestamp_note: processing status triggers maybe_set_date_paid, so COD orders get a paid timestamp before any money is collected

authority.note: Sync being on does not change which store is authoritative; read only the authoritative store.

columns.updated: wc_orders.date_updated_gmt (datetime, UTC, NULL allowed; set from date_modified, which persist_updates() fills on every CRUD save that did not set it)

hpos.indexes: wc_orders has type_status_date (type, status, date_created_gmt) and date_updated (date_updated_gmt); wc_order_operational_data has no index on date_paid_gmt

legacy.paid_precedence: use _date_paid when its first row is truthy (non-empty and not '0'); otherwise _paid_date
legacy.date_paid_format: UTC Unix seconds as a numeric string; empty string when unset
legacy.paid_date_legacy_format: Y-m-d H:i:s in the site's local time (WC_DateTime::date); parse in the store timezone for that local time, not today's offset; empty string when unset
legacy.duplicate_meta: WordPress loads meta ORDER BY meta_id ASC and WooCommerce reads [0], so the lowest meta_id row of a key wins

edit_url.hpos_side_effect: the helper calls wc_get_order() under HPOS and writes a debug log entry when the order is missing; build the shop_order URL directly to avoid hydration and log writes

hold_stock.cancellation_runs_when: held minutes >= 1 AND woocommerce_manage_stock === 'yes' AND the woocommerce_cancel_unpaid_orders_interval_minutes filter result >= 1
hold_stock.selects: pending orders of any registered order type whose last modified time is older than the hold window (not creation time)
hold_stock.scheduler: Action Scheduler hook woocommerce_cancel_unpaid_orders, group woocommerce (WP-Cron fallback)
hold_stock.parse: absent option uses the core default '60'; empty, 0 or non-numeric means not configured; positive integer with stock management on is configuration evidence, not proof a cancellation ran

logging.default_handler: LoggingUtil::get_default_handler() (constant WC_LOG_HANDLER, then option woocommerce_logs_default_handler, default Automattic\WooCommerce\Internal\Admin\Logging\LogHandlerFileV2)
logging.level_threshold: LoggingUtil::get_level_threshold() (constant WC_LOG_THRESHOLD, then option woocommerce_logs_level_threshold, default 'none' meaning all levels)
logging.retention_days: LoggingUtil::get_retention_period() (filter woocommerce_logger_days_to_retain_logs, else option woocommerce_logs_retention_period_days, default 30)
logging.log_directory: LoggingUtil::get_log_directory( false ) - pass false; the default true creates the directory
logging.file_name: <source>-YYYY-MM-DD-<hash>.log; source is everything before the last 4 dash segments; rotated files add .<n> to the source
logging.file_line: <ISO-8601 UTC 'c' time> <LEVEL upper case> <message>[ CONTEXT: <json>]; filterable by woocommerce_format_log_entry
logging.db_table: {prefix}woocommerce_log (log_id, timestamp datetime UTC, level smallint, source varchar(200), message longtext, context longtext NULL); index on level only
logging.legacy_add_default_level: WC_Logger::add( $handle, $message ) logs at notice unless a level is passed (includes/class-wc-logger.php:136, unchanged in 11.2.2 and 11.3.0)
